hypotheses.justification: The statement only involves `phi G hp d`, which is defined in section Tower without any CharP assumption, so this instance is not needed to elaborate the statement. The proof needs it only indirectly, through `eq_zero_of_forall_phi` → `coeff_mem_pow` → `coeff_mem_maximalIdeal_of_phi_eq_zero`, and it follows from the other hypotheses `[Fact p.Prime]` and `hp : (p : R) ∈ maximalIdeal R`. Mapping to the residue field gives `(p : kk R) = 0`, and for prime `p` this gives `CharP (kk R) p` via `CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero`. The library's own `solution` theorem (lines 966-969) derives the instance exactly this way: `haveI : CharP (kk R) p := by refine (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero Fact.out).2 ?_; rw [← map_natCast (residue R), IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]; exact hp`. Adding that `haveI` at the start of the proof and keeping the rest unchanged proves the theorem without the binder (use `omit [CharP (kk R) p] in`).
